title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory
abstract: arXiv:2608.30647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models can answer from precomputed memory, a model's saved reading of a body of material, reused across requests instead of read again at each. This paper maps where that practice preserves correctness and the conditions under which it fails. Across experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using both saved key-value caches and trained compressions of them, precomputed memory degrades when assembled from separately prepared parts, stays current only through rebuilds costing a large fraction of full preparation in our measurements, and ignores corrections served beside it conditional on phrasing. If precomputed memories can be served alongside one another, be cost-efficiently rebuilt, and be superseded by new information arriving in real-time, they can serve as a way to avoid re-feeding context to a model over repeated queries. translated_title: 组装、重建与纠正预计算记忆的代价
translated_abstract: 语言模型可以从预计算记忆中回答问题——预计算记忆是模型对一批材料所保存的“阅读结果”，可在多个请求之间重复使用，而无需在每次请求时重新读取。本文绘制了这种做法在哪些情况下能保持正确性，以及在何种条件下会失效。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上的实验中，同时使用了保存的键值缓存（KV cache）及其经过训练的压缩版本，结果表明：预计算记忆在由分别准备的部分组装时会退化；只有通过重建才能保持最新，而在我们的测量中重建成本占完整准备成本的很大一部分；并且它会忽略与之一同提供的纠正信息，是否接受纠正还取决于措辞。如果预计算记忆能够彼此并行服务、能够以高性价比方式重建、并且能够被实时到达的新信息所取代，那么它们可以作为一种避免在重复查询中反复向模型输入上下文的方案。我们的结果对于处理多样化查询的已部署系统的启示是，预计算……
tldr: 本文系统测量了语言模型使用预计算记忆（如保存的KV缓存及其训练压缩版本）的代价：由独立部分组装的记忆会退化、保持更新需要高昂的重建成本、且对随附纠正的接受与否取决于措辞，从而揭示了预计算记忆作为避免重复输入上下文方案所面临的正确性与成本限制。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically measures the costs of precomputed memory in language models—showing that memories assembled from separately prepared parts degrade, staying current requires expensive rebuilds, and corrections are heeded only depending on phrasing—revealing key correctness and cost limitations of precomputed memory as a way to avoid re-feeding context across repeated queries.
